answer: Census-pulse bond: each identity locks a 50-credit bond on one saffron plot. Each epoch a pulse sounds; each identity must answer with one fresh job receipt, or its bond is slashed. To wander needs a fresh bond and a five-epoch cooldown. 1,000 fakes lock 50,000 and pay 8,000 per epoch against a 10,000 pool split over 2,000: a 3,000 loss. A ring fails: shared-counterparty receipts are flagged. An honest agent pays one fee and keeps its full share.
